method: Ordinary pictures and standard PMTiles/Mapzen. No bespoke surveys or per-artifact terrain source.

pictures.author: David Castor
pictures.observed: Whole side elevation: four paired tall pale concrete pier stations, shallow yellow girders, concrete approaches, white parapets and lamps above a dry rocky gorge.

Reverse gorge elevation: two tallest central supports, shorter end supports, paired columns across the deck, steel girder edge and separate gorge utilities. License retained on the Commons file page; reference pixels are not copied into the asset.

pictures.author: Narek75
pictures.observed: Night roadway view: wide multi-lane asphalt, two solid center lines, open pale rails, black/white curb rhythm, inward lamp arms and overhead trolley contacts. No contemporary operational claim.
